title: Binary, constant relative volatility 2.5, saturated vapour feed, distillate too small
purpose: (e) Specifications with no physical solution: with a saturated-vapour feed of 100 mol/s, a reflux ratio of 1 and a distillate of 20 mol/s, the vapour above the feed (40 mol/s) is less than the feed's vapour, so the boil-up would be -60 mol/s. Expected: a refusal (invalid_input) or not_converged, never a profile with a negative flow.
method_choice: constant-alpha model system (no method to choose)

thermo.note: A model system, not a real mixture: K_i = alpha_i p(T) / P with the reference vapour pressure p(T) above (made up; it only fixes the temperatures), liquid enthalpy 0 and vapour enthalpy equal to the latent heat for every component, so the energy balances give constant molar overflow exactly. docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md does not apply: there is no real mixture to choose a method for.

expected.never: a converged result, or a profile with a negative flow
behaviour: the message says which specification to change (a larger distillate or reflux ratio)
a solver failure is not reported as an impossible separation, and an impossible separation is not reported as converged

tolerances.not_numerical: a refusal; the reference only states the constant-molar-overflow arithmetic (fixture: checks.boilup)
